key_insight: AlB₁₂–Al detonation coatings improved Steel 45 wear resistance, with AB70 showing stable friction and wear characteristics.
engineering_relevance: These coatings offer a potential wear-protection option for steel components operating under sliding contact.
method: Deposited AB70 (70 wt.% AlB₁₂, 30 wt.% Al) and AB30 (30 wt.% AlB₁₂, 70 wt.% Al) using DNEPR-5M.
Characterized coating thickness, hardness, and surface structure.
Evaluated friction and wear under varying sliding speeds and loads.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports coating thicknesses of approximately 170–200 μm and AB70 friction coefficients of 0.21–0.38 with wear rates of 3.3–8.6 μm/km; coated samples outperformed uncoated Steel 45.
watch_item: Oxidative and adhesive-abrasive wear were observed, but the abstract omits detailed test conditions needed to define a reliable operating envelope.
paper_title: Structure and properties of AlB12-Al detonation coatings on steel 45
